list.title: Accounts
list.subtitle: Where your money is: banks, cards, wallets and cash.

empty.activeBody: Create your first account to start recording transactions.
empty.inactiveBody: When you deactivate an account it will show up here so you can still look it up.

deactivate.question: Deactivate “{{name}}”? You will not be able to record new transactions in it; you can still look it up.

form.createSubtitle: Give it a name you recognize, pick its currency, and say how much money it starts with.
form.editSubtitle: The currency can only change while the account has no transactions.
form.readOnly: This account is deactivated: you can look it up, but you cannot edit it or record new transactions in it.
form.readOnlyCurrency: This account uses a currency that is no longer supported: you can look it up, but you cannot edit it or record new transactions in it.
form.identityLocked: This account already has transactions, so its name and currency cannot change.
form.balanceHint: It can be negative, such as a card's debt. Up to {{decimals}} decimals.
form.balanceRequired: Enter the opening balance; use 0 if the account starts empty.
form.balanceInvalid: Enter a number with up to {{decimals}} decimals.
form.balanceTooLarge: The balance cannot have more than {{digits}} whole digits.
form.openingHint: When the account started; it cannot be later than now.

errors.ACCOUNT_NAME_REQUIRED: Enter a name for the account.
errors.ACCOUNT_NAME_MAX_LENGTH: The name can be up to {{nameMax}} characters.
errors.ACCOUNT_NAME_LOCKED: The account already has transactions, so its name cannot change.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this account.
errors.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_INVALID: That currency is not available. Pick one from the list.
errors.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_LOCKED: The account already has transactions, so its currency cannot change.
errors.ACCOUNT_OPENING_DATE_REQUIRED: Enter the day and time you opened the account.
errors.ACCOUNT_OPENING_DATE_FUTURE: The opening date cannot be later than now.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED_BY_CLOSED_PERIOD: You can't change the opening balance or currency: there are closed months since this account opened. Reopen them first.
